description: Place an outbound AI phone call to set up a meeting. The assistant calls the person, agrees a time, and the result (poll get_call) carries outcome (appointment_set | callback_requested | declined | no_answer | failed) and, when set, the appointment (startISO, timezone, durationMinutes, attendee, subject). Returns a callId immediately.

autoBook.description: Also book the agreed time on your connected calendar.

callerId.description: Optional caller ID; must be a number on your account.

slots.description: Specific start times to offer, ISO-8601 with offset.

timePreference.description: Natural-language window, e.g. "weekday mornings next week".

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the appointment, e.g. Asia/Jerusalem.

to.description: Who to call, in E.164, e.g. +14155550123.

webhookUrl.description: Optional https URL to receive the signed result.

name: set_appointment
title: Set an appointment by phone
